fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Just a few minutes from Teneriffe, Precision Dental in Fortitude Valley offers a quieter, more personal dental experience. Whether you have put off visiting for a while or you are planning a bigger change to your smile, we are here to help at a pace that feels right.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: About Precision Dental

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many Teneriffe residents enjoy the calm of riverside living, and we think a dental visit should feel similarly settled. We allow time in each appointment to ask questions, talk through concerns and leave feeling informed rather than hurried.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Memory-foam chairs support you through longer treatment, and our team explains each step before it happens. Learn more About Precision Dental and the people behind it.

fields.value: Care for Anxious Patients

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If fear has kept you away, our care for anxious patients begins with a simple conversation. There is no expectation to start treatment until you feel ready, and happy gas is available if it helps.

fields.value: Restorative Dentistry

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Missing or worn teeth can affect how you eat and smile. Our Restorative Dentistry options include dental implants, bridges, crowns and dentures, each discussed with its benefits, risks and costs.

fields.label: Paragraph

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: General and Emergency Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our General Dentistry services keep teeth and gums healthy with routine check-ups, while our Emergency Dentistry team is available for sudden pain or damage.

sections.label: Why Teneriffe Patients Choose Precision Dental

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Teneriffe Patients Choose Precision Dental

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Honesty

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We will never judge you for how long it has been since your last visit, and we will always explain your options plainly and fairly.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Comfort

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Agreeing on a stop signal before we begin puts you in control, and you are welcome to bring your own music.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Quality

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Dr Billy Choi is a member of the Australian Society of Implant Dentistry and plans implant treatment using a digital OPG and careful assessment.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Convenience

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our team can stage larger treatment plans across several visits so they suit your schedule and budget.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Safety

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: As an accredited practice, we meet national standards for clinical governance and infection control.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Special Offers and Patient Benefits

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For larger treatment such as implants, eligible patients may be able to explore early release of superannuation with the help of SuperCare, or spread costs through DentiCare payment plans, subject to eligibility, terms and conditions.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: It has been years since I saw a dentist. Where do I start?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Book a consultation and let us know how you are feeling. We will start with a conversation and plan any treatment in manageable steps.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What does happy gas feel like?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many people describe a light, relaxed feeling. You stay awake and able to talk with us throughout.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Am I suitable for dental implants?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Suitability depends on your bone, gum health and general health. We assess this with a clinical examination and imaging.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How long does implant treatment take?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Treatment is usually staged over several months to allow healing. We explain the expected timeline at your consultation.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What is the difference between porcelain and composite veneers?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Porcelain veneers are made in ceramic and generally resist staining well, while composite veneers are shaped directly on the tooth and are easier to repair.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I bring a support person to my appointment?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. You are welcome to bring someone with you.
